nodes.label: Badminton App Project Guide (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Internal app for a badminton group: organizer creates a session, ticks who came, enters court/water/shuttlecock costs, and the app splits the total per person.

nodes.label: Module 0: Cleanup & Foundation Plan
nodes.rationale: Turn the uncommitted scaffold into a clean committed foundation: no test tooling, shadcn/ui installed, English docs; no product features.

nodes.label: Module 1: Supabase, Host Login & First Deploy Plan
nodes.norm_label: module 1: supabase, host login & first deploy plan
nodes.rationale: Connect to Supabase, let the host log in/out with email + password, protect /admin, deploy on Vercel from a private GitHub repo.

nodes.label: Module 2: Member List Plan
nodes.rationale: Host keeps the group's fixed member list (add, rename, remove by nickname) on /admin, stored in Supabase.

nodes.label: Badminton README
nodes.rationale: Schedule badminton sessions and split court, water and shuttlecock costs across the group; Next.js + Supabase on Vercel.

nodes.label: English Repo Docs, Vietnamese UI Text
nodes.norm_label: english repo docs, vietnamese ui text

nodes.label: Use auth.getClaims(), Never getSession() on the Server
nodes.norm_label: use auth.getclaims(), never getsession() on the server

nodes.label: Unlinked noindex Editing Pages (/admin, /login)
nodes.rationale: Viewing needs no login; editing pages are not linked from public pages, are marked noindex and are deliberately not listed in robots.txt.

nodes.label: Members Archived via archived_at, Never Deleted
nodes.norm_label: members archived via archived_at, never deleted
nodes.rationale: Past sessions keep their members' names.

nodes.label: Money as Integer VND (format only for display)
nodes.norm_label: money as integer vnd (format only for display)
nodes.rationale: Money is always stored as an integer number of VND and formatted only at display time with formatVND.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Agent Rules (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs. training data; agents must read the bundled guide before writing code. The block is managed and re-added by `next dev`.

nodes.label: No Automated Tests (verify with format:check, lint, typecheck, build)
nodes.norm_label: no automated tests (verify with format:check, lint, typecheck, build)
nodes.rationale: Owner's decision: no test suite; correctness is checked by formatting, lint, typecheck and production build plus manual checks.

nodes.label: No Per-account Row Ownership (no host_id)
nodes.rationale: Every signed-in account edits the same data; supersedes the host-only, host_id-scoped design of the Module 2 plan.

nodes.label: Proxy Is Only an Optimistic Redirect
nodes.norm_label: proxy is only an optimistic redirect
nodes.rationale: src/proxy.ts redirects early but does not replace server-side authorization checks.

nodes.label: Public View, Any Signed-in Account Edits
nodes.norm_label: public view, any signed-in account edits
nodes.rationale: Internal app: anyone can view members, sessions and costs without logging in; login is only for editing, and any signed-in account can edit everything.

nodes.label: requireHost() First in Every Admin Page and Server Action
nodes.norm_label: requirehost() first in every admin page and server action

nodes.label: RLS + Column-level Grants Convention (public SELECT, no DELETE)
nodes.norm_label: rls + column-level grants convention (public select, no delete)
nodes.rationale: Every table enables RLS, grants anon and authenticated SELECT (everything public to view), grants authenticated only the columns it writes, no DELETE grants; read policies use (true), write policies check (select auth.uid()) is not null.

nodes.label: Supabase Sign-ups Disabled; Owner Creates Accounts
nodes.norm_label: supabase sign-ups disabled; owner creates accounts
nodes.rationale: With shared editing, being signed in is the only gate for writes, so nobody must be able to self-register.

nodes.label: Timestamped SQL Migrations Applied by the Owner
nodes.norm_label: timestamped sql migrations applied by the owner
nodes.rationale: Schema changes are new timestamped files in supabase/migrations/; applied files are never edited. The owner runs each file in the Supabase SQL Editor in filename order; agents write SQL but never run it.

nodes.label: src/ Folder Structure (app, components/ui, features, lib, server)
nodes.norm_label: src/ folder structure (app, components/ui, features, lib, server)
nodes.rationale: app/ is routing only and stays thin; features/<name> holds per-feature components, actions and logic; lib/ is pure helpers without React or DB; server/ is server-only and never imported from client components.

nodes.label: Geist --font-sans Self-reference Fix
nodes.rationale: shadcn init writes a self-referencing `--font-sans: var(--font-sans)` that silently breaks the font, so Vietnamese diacritics would not render in Geist.

nodes.label: Light-only Theme (class-based .dark replaces prefers-color-scheme)
nodes.rationale: A phone in dark mode must still show readable text; the app stays light-only until a theme toggle exists.

nodes.label: package-lock.json Must Match package.json
nodes.rationale: Vercel installs from package-lock.json, so after removing/adding packages the lockfile must stay in sync (checked with npm ls --depth=0).

nodes.label: cacheComponents: Cookie Reads Must Render Inside <Suspense>
nodes.norm_label: cachecomponents: cookie reads must render inside <suspense>
nodes.rationale: With cacheComponents on, any component reading cookies (Supabase server client, requireHost) outside <Suspense> or at a layout's top level makes next build fail.

nodes.label: RLS Write Policies Must Check the Host's User ID
nodes.norm_label: rls write policies must check the host's user id
nodes.rationale: Planned rule: from Module 2, write policies check the host's user id, not just 'authenticated'. Superseded by AGENTS.md, where write policies check (select auth.uid()) is not null.

nodes.label: Owner-gated Outward Actions (private GitHub repo, push, SQL)
nodes.norm_label: owner-gated outward actions (private github repo, push, sql)
nodes.rationale: Creating the GitHub repo, pushing and running SQL against Supabase are outward-facing, so the executor asks the owner first.

nodes.label: Publishable Key Ships to Every Browser (self sign-up risk)
nodes.norm_label: publishable key ships to every browser (self sign-up risk)
nodes.rationale: If Supabase sign-ups are on, anyone can create an account and become 'authenticated', which database rules would trust; verified by probing /auth/v1/signup for signup_disabled.

nodes.label: Exactly One Host Account (email + password)
nodes.rationale: Original scope: only the host logs in, only to edit. Later broadened in AGENTS.md to any signed-in account editing shared data.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Index on Active Nicknames (lower(nickname) where archived_at is null)
nodes.norm_label: partial unique index on active nicknames (lower(nickname) where archived_at is null)
nodes.rationale: Active nicknames are unique ignoring case; archived rows keep history and do not block re-adding the same nickname.

nodes.label: Host-only Members RLS (host_id = auth.uid(), anon revoked)
nodes.norm_label: host-only members rls (host_id = auth.uid(), anon revoked)
nodes.rationale: Planned design: only the host reads or writes members; anon has no privileges because the publishable key ships to every browser. Superseded by the public-read / shared-edit model in AGENTS.md (migration 20261109160000_public_read_shared_edit.sql).

nodes.label: Nickname Normalization Rules (NFC, trim, collapse spaces, 1-30 code points)
nodes.norm_label: nickname normalization rules (nfc, trim, collapse spaces, 1-30 code points)
nodes.rationale: Length is counted in code points (Array.from) to match Postgres char_length; unique among active members ignoring case.

nodes.label: requireHost() First, RLS as Second Line
nodes.norm_label: requirehost() first, rls as second line

nodes.label: Vercel Deploy Pinned to sin1 (Singapore)
nodes.rationale: Serverless functions are pinned to sin1 via vercel.json to stay close to the Singapore database.

nodes.label: Member Write Error Mapping (23505 duplicate, 22P02 / zero rows not_found)
nodes.norm_label: member write error mapping (23505 duplicate, 22p02 / zero rows not_found)
nodes.rationale: Maps Postgres errors to duplicate / not_found / error; covers stale tabs renaming or removing an already-removed member.

nodes.label: refresh() After Successful Write (no revalidatePath)
nodes.rationale: Member data is not cached, so actions call refresh() from next/cache instead of revalidatePath/updateTag.

nodes.label: Login Error Handling (Vietnamese errors, button disabled while pending)
nodes.norm_label: login error handling (vietnamese errors, button disabled while pending)

nodes.label: Stale or Tampered Session Cookie Redirects to /login (never 500)
nodes.norm_label: stale or tampered session cookie redirects to /login (never 500)

nodes.label: Copy Rotated Session Cookies onto Redirect Response
nodes.norm_label: copy rotated session cookies onto redirect response
nodes.rationale: When the proxy redirects, cookies Supabase just rotated must be copied onto the redirect response or the host gets logged out at random.

nodes.label: Clear Missing Env Var Error
nodes.rationale: Missing env vars on Vercel should produce an error naming the variable instead of a cryptic Supabase failure.
